verdict.rationale: Motion has a live, documented REST API, but the evidence describes it only as covering projects and tasks. Booking features such as meeting templates, custom availability and embedded booking pages appear only as UI features, with no evidence of API endpoints for them. The existing API is an adjacent capability, not the event-type, availability and booking API this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented REST API lets me manage event types, availability, and bookings programmatically — enough to build scheduling into my own product

citations.quote: API access for creating, updating, and managing projects and tasks.
